description: This file defines the RecommendationRepository class, which handles database CRUD operations related to recommendations, including creating recommendations and listing them by analysis.

classes.name: RecommendationRepository
classes.description: Repository class for performing CRUD operations on recommendations in the database.

methods.name: int create(self, analysis_id: int, job_id: int, score: float)
methods.description: Asynchronously inserts a new recommendation record into the database and returns its ID.

methods.name: List[dict] list_by_analysis(self, analysis_id: int)
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of recommendations associated with a specific analysis ID, ordered by score.
